d: Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates a portfolio of 29 exceptional properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, Asia, and Africa. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and since then the brand has become known for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels, and exclusive branded residences. Jumeirah is synonymous with Arabian luxury hospitality and the ability to craft distinctive, purposeful experiences for the world’s most discerning travellers.

Located on the pristine beaches of Bahrain’s West Coast, the resort features stunning ocean views, verdant greenery, and meandering waterways with modern, spacious rooms and suites as well as an exclusive Gulf Summer House, located directly on the beach. Guests can enjoy a variety of water sports activities, the resort’s five pools, and book treatments at Jumeirah’s signature Talise Spa.
q: The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:
At least 3 to 4 years Bartending/Mixologist experience (preferably within the international hospitality industry).
Proven experience as a Mixologist, Senior Bartender, or similar role, preferably in a luxury hotel, resort, restaurant, or high-end bar.
Strong knowledge of spirits, liqueurs, wines, bitters, syrups, fresh ingredients, and cocktail techniques.
Demonstrated experience in cocktail menu creation and beverage program development.
Good understanding of beverage costing, inventory management, and stock control.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment.

li
Identify and meet guests’ needs, provide appropriate bar services, and assist guests in recommendations, upselling where appropriate to provide knowledgeable and bespoke service
li
Lead and supervise bartenders and bar staff during daily operations.
li
Create, develop, and maintain innovative cocktail and beverage menus.
li
Establish and maintain recipes, specifications, garnishes, and presentation standards.
li
Ensure consistency and quality of all cocktails and beverages.
li

li
Monitor beverage inventory, stock levels, wastage, and product quality.
li
Assist with purchasing and maintain good relationships with suppliers.
x: We offer an attractive tax-free salary, paid in Bahraini Dinar (BHD), the local currency of Bahrain. In addition, we offer reduced hotel rates across our properties globally, excellent leave and health care package, flights home, accommodation, life insurance, 50% discount off Jumeirah F&B Outlets and reduced hotel rates.

Industry: Cargo & Courier / Freight Forwarding / Logistics

We are looking for a detail-oriented and commercially focused Pricing Executive to manage cargo and courier pricing, prepare competitive quotations, coordinate with airlines and agents, and support the Sales and Operations teams. The candidate should have good knowledge of international cargo rates, airline pricing, freight calculations, and UAE cargo market practices.
q: 1–3 years of experience in pricing, cargo, courier, freight forwarding, or logistics.
Experience in air cargo / courier pricing is preferred.
Good knowledge of air freight rates, chargeable weight, volumetric weight, and freight calculations .
Familiarity with major airline/courier services and international destinations.
Good knowledge of Excel and MS Office .
Ability to work under pressure and meet urgent quotation deadlines.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Good coordination skills with Sales, Operations, Airlines, and Agents.
UAE cargo/logistics market experience is preferred.
Good command of English ; Hindi and Malayalam .
Cargo & Courier / Freight Forwarding experience preferred.
Candidates with strong knowledge of air cargo pricing and overseas agent rates will have an advantage.
